Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. With more than 130 years of financial experience and nearly 20,000 partners, we serve some of the world’s most sophisticated clients through leading technology and exceptional service. The Omnium technology organization develops and supports mission-critical financial platforms serving complex investment and asset servicing needs. Omnium supports capabilities across areas including pricing, accounting, trading, financial instrument processing, and regulatory functions. The platform combines internally developed technology with best-in-class partner solutions while maintaining an integrated system of record that provides transparency, control, and operational efficiency. The technologists building and supporting Omnium are thought leaders who work directly with the people who use our software every day. Our engineers are expected to understand the business problems they are solving, take ownership of their solutions, and continuously improve the resiliency, performance, security, and maintainability of the platform. The successful candidate will bring 10+ years of software engineering experience with strong hands-on expertise in C# and .NET backend development. The individual will work on a large and complex codebase supporting critical pricing, accounting, regulatory, and financial-processing capabilities . The role will involve both functional development and technical modernization, including enhancements to existing services, development of new backend capabilities, framework and dependency upgrades, performance improvements, security remediation, and improvements to the overall maintainability and resiliency of the platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role requiring the ability to independently own complex technical initiatives from analysis and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. The candidate should be comfortable working with minimal technical supervision while collaborating effectively with cross-functional engineering, architecture, product, and business teams. Strong experience with SQL Server and T-SQL, including relational data modeling, query development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. Experience working with large, mature enterprise codebases, including modernization and enhancement of existing applications. Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, SOLID principles, design patterns, asynchronous programming, concurrency, error handling, and application resiliency. Experience designing and developing secure, scalable, performant, maintainable, and testable production applications. Strong experience with unit testing, debugging, code reviews, source control, automated builds, and CI/CD-based software delivery. Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex technical problems and drive solutions through completion. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into well-designed technical solutions. Experience collaborating effectively across engineering, architecture, product, infrastructure, and business teams. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain backend services and APIs using C# and modern .NET technologies. Enhance and modernize existing Omnium applications supporting pricing, accounting, regulatory, and related financial-processing capabilities. Develop new backend capabilities and extend existing applications to support evolving business and client requirements. Take ownership of complex technical changes from initial analysis and solution design through implementation and production deployment. Develop reusable backend components, services, and libraries that improve engineering consistency and accelerate future development. Produce secure, efficient, maintainable, well-documented, and well-tested code consistent with enterprise engineering standards. Modernize legacy components and dependencies, including .NET framework and runtime upgrades and remediation of technical debt. Identify and address performance, scalability, reliability, security, and resiliency issues across backend applications and services. Troubleshoot complex application and production issues and perform effective root-cause analysis. Participate actively in solution design, technical discussions, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement of engineering practices. Work closely with other Omnium and enterprise technology teams on cross-application dependencies and strategic technology initiatives. Contribute to improvements in automated testing, CI/CD, observability, application monitoring, and overall software delivery quality. Participate in production support and ensure applications meet appropriate operational, resiliency, and service-level expectations. Proactively identify opportunities to simplify the technology landscape, reduce technical debt, and improve engineering efficiency. Financial Services Experience working within financial services, capital markets, asset servicing, investment accounting, pricing, or trading platforms. Experience developing systems supporting high-volume or complex financial transactions. Understanding of financial instruments, pricing, accounting, or regulatory processing is advantageous. Azure and Cloud Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, particularly building, deploying, or supporting enterprise applications and backend services in Azure. Familiarity with Azure technologies such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Key Vault, API Management, and Azure Monitor/Application Insights. Experience with cloud-native and containerized application development, including Docker and Kubernetes. Familiarity with cloud architecture principles involving scalability, resiliency, security, observability, and automated deployment. Experience with messaging or event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka or Azure messaging services. AI and Generative AI Exposure to Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Large Language Model technologies is a plus. Experience integrating enterprise applications with LLMs, AI APIs, or AI-enabled services is advantageous. Familiarity with Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, or similar enterprise AI platforms. Understanding of how AI capabilities can be securely integrated into existing enterprise applications and engineering workflows. Familiarity with AI engineering concepts such as prompt engineering, evaluation, observability, security, responsible AI, and production integration is desirable. Interest in identifying practical opportunities to apply AI to improve software engineering, operational processes, or financial-services workflows. Additional Technology Experience with application observability, telemetry, logging, and production monitoring. Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures. Exposure to Go or Node.js development is a plus. Professional Skills Highly motivated, self-directed, and accountable for delivering results. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Demonstrates the ability to investigate beyond the immediate symptoms of a problem and identify underlying technical or process issues. Able to understand complex technical and business concepts quickly. Detail-oriented while maintaining an understanding of broader architectural and business impacts. Comfortable working in a complex technology environment with changing priorities and multiple concurrent deliverables. Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex assignments and drive them through completion. Proactively identifies opportunities to improve engineering quality, operational efficiency, platform stability, and maintainability. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Able to communicate complex technical concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and organizational boundaries. Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership, accountability, engineering discipline, and commitment to quality. Working with Us As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain applications using C# and .NET technologies. Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to deliver solutions. Develop APIs, microservices, and event-driven integrations. Support production systems and drive continuous improvements. Participate in solution design, code reviews, and Agile delivery processes. Required Skills 6–10 years of software development experience. Strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET/.NET Core, and SQL Server. Experience with REST APIs, microservices, and Kafka. Knowledge of Azure Cloud and CI/CD practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferred Experience in financial services, capital markets, or regulatory reporting. Exposure to cloud-native architectures and DevOps practices. Join us in building modern, scalable platforms that support critical regulatory reporting and business processes. We get curious people invested in the world When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on. You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success. We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations. When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense. At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future! How To Apply Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!
